title: Tilt focus
description: A sharply focused strip cuts through a blurred concrete elevation, with an adjustable tilt and depth.
useCase: Explore an image focal plane through direct manipulation and precise controls.
interaction: Drag the focal plane and adjust blur or tilt.
reducedMotion: The focal plane responds directly to controls without interpolated movement.
limitations: A CSS mask over one photograph approximates a focal plane; it does not reconstruct optical depth.
look: Blurred greyscale photo of a concrete cantilever with one sharp horizontal band under a thin red guide line; pale footer with two red sliders.
motion: Dragging on the photo moves a sharp masked band directly with the pointer, no easing; sliders set its position and blur radius, and a button angles the band.
adapt: Two stacked `img` layers do the work: `tf-soft` gets `blur(${aperture}px)` and `tf-sharp` is masked by the `mask` gradient around `focus` (±7% sharp, ±22% feather). Replace the `src` photo and `alt` text; tune the stop offsets and `aperture` range.
